issues.on_page: Grants and donations 111,195 (Fire 101,297, Cemetery 3,130, Other Governmental 6,768); p2 shows them as Operating Grants and Contributions
issues.issue: 101,297 sits in the Fire fund and may be government grants (intergovernmental/federal) rather than private donations. It has a review note, but the category is a judgment call on a large amount.

issues.extracted: Taxes 667,830 split into property 466,496 / sales 146,048 / motor vehicle 46,980 / occupation 1,000 / special assessment 7,306
issues.on_page: p2 Statement of Activities general receipts, governmental column; the five items sum exactly to 667,830
issues.issue: The split uses the statement of activities general receipts, which the rules allow, and the arithmetic holds. The p4 fund statement doesn't itself print the breakdown, and putting special assessments inside 'Taxes' is an inference from the totals matching.

issues.extracted: detail = Water/Sewer operating lines from the p6 business-type basic statement
issues.on_page: p6 is a basic statement; the only supplementary schedule (p7) gives fund totals only
issues.issue: The detail lines come from a basic statement, not a supplementary schedule, and cover operating lines only. Nonoperating per-fund lines (interest income 78/2,712, loan payments 28,970, capital projects 253,883/30,850) are left out, and the governmental per-fund columns on p4 are not in detail. The approach isn't consistent, though nothing is double counted inside detail.
